operational_impact: High winds trigger crane wind alerts, suspension of quay container crane operations, and harbor pilotage aborts.
Significant wave heights force vessel slow steaming, outer anchorage drift, and delays in pilot boarding.
Localized convective storms cause flash flooding of rail intermodal yards, drayage road closures, and gate halts.
Macro disasters (earthquakes, monsoons, nationwide industrial halts) suppress national import/export cargo flows.

coverage_scope: 36 US Major Freight Hubs (92,052 daily observations)
operational_impact: Identifies ports operating in structural overload; high pressure ratios precede container dwell explosions.
